===== This document is only for Level-C personnel =====
*** NEXT PETROL INTERNAL MEMO ***
STATUS: CODE YELLOW | ATTENTION LOCATION: ISLAND MAIN SECTOR ISSUE: Jason Santos - Code: 19922302-439 DATE: 20260707
// MEMO // The helicopter rescue was carried out successfully. Twenty-five people received a safe vaccine, including two asymptomatic individuals. The asymptomatic individuals were quarantined at the military prison facility, each in their own cell. One of them died, and the other was infected but did not show any symptoms. Doctor Wu Wang sent him back to work on the platforms.
When the second asymptomatic individual got hurt, some blood spilled onto another worker. They took him to the medical unit for an urgent vaccination. After being quarantined for 30 days, no test data appeared, so the Director put him back to work at the market under surveillance. Two days later, she was bitten by a wild boar. The animal was killed and taken to the market.
After some people ate the boar meat, a family became sick and locked themselves at home. Doctors went to check on them and never came back.
